findings.text: FULL W2 SCOPE DELIVERED WITH NO DODGE AND THE READ-ONLY PHYSICS IS REAL (the crux for this safety-critical plan). The write path is STRUCTURALLY ABSENT (no write-family method on the responder's ReadHandle or ReadOnlyCredential, class or instance), not a flippable policy flag; the seam refuses a write submitted with the responder's credential and the store is unchanged; the refusal is non-vacuous (a write-granted credential the responder never holds applies the same write); and the load-bearing tooth is RED under mutation (granting the responder's credential write makes the seam allow the write). Redaction runs before context and leaks on drop, every query lands in the audit, raw secrets never surface, and the broker refuses free-form/over-row/over-rate/over-timeout/unknown-source by name with a positive control. Unlike prior W-items caught dropping mandated behavior, nothing here is dropped or substituted. A write cannot slip through the responder's credential.

THE WRITE-CAPABLE CREDENTIAL IS A FREELY-INSTANTIABLE FAKE-PLANE FIXTURE, and this is the correct scope for W2 (not blocking). FakeEvidencePlane.submit_write authorizes by the Python-level credential.grants property, and WriteCapableCredential (grants read+write) can be constructed by name by any caller holding the module - so the 'write is impossible' guarantee for the responder rests on TWO things this item genuinely delivers plus ONE thing it correctly defers: (a) delivered - the responder's types carry no write method, so a write cannot be EXPRESSED through the credential the responder holds; (b) delivered - open_read_only is the ONLY credential factory and yields only a read-only-granted credential, and WriteCapableCredential is documented as never returned by it and not part of the responder's harness; (c) deferred, correctly - 'the responder never holds a write credential' becomes a structural harness property in WARP-1204 (W4), whose harness contains no execution capability, and in a real deployment the data store authorizes by the actual read-only secret material, not a Python property (the fake's grants-based check MODELS that role-based authz). W2's claim is scoped exactly to the credential seam and is sound; no write slips through the responder's own credential. Recommendation for W4: ensure the responder harness structurally cannot import or construct WriteCapableCredential (or any write-granted credential) so the model closes end to end.

AN UNKNOWN-SOURCE QUERY IS NOT AUDITED (minor, non-blocking). Broker.query calls _source(source_id) first, which raises EvidencePlaneError('unknown evidence source') before any audit.record, so a query naming a non-existent source_id leaves no audit entry - unlike a free-form/over-quota/over-timeout query, which is audited before it refuses. This does not violate AC3's scope ('every query issued during a seeded investigation'), because a seeded investigation targets declared sources and every such query (allowed or refused) is audited (I confirmed 4/4). But an unknown-source query is arguably still 'a query the responder ran'. Recommendation for the W4 responder loop or a later hardening: record a 'refused:unknown_source' audit entry before raising, so the audit is a complete record of every attempted read including mis-targeted ones. Not a W2 defect.

HONEST DEFERRALS AND GENERATED-FILE HANDLING ARE CORRECT. The run_all wiring and init lay-down are deferred to WARP-1211 (W11), matching how W1 (WARP-1201) shipped its contract validator unwired; because validate.py is not edited it stays at 925 lines under the module_lines budget (the same over-budget concern the WARP-1201 verdict flagged for the orchestrator still applies to W11 but is not this item's debt - W2 correctly did not touch it). specs/index.md is changed in the commit but is a GENERATED artifact (regenerated by update_index.py, check_generated clean, no drift), outside the declared footprint yet exempt as generated, consistent with the WARP-1201 commit. The capabilities entry, the spec, and the module docstrings honestly name W3/W4/W5/W6/W7, the live connection, and W11 as later separate acts and imply nothing is built that is not.
